newsitem.title: USA: Culbro says conditions met for distribution.
newsitem.headline: Culbro says conditions met for distribution.

text.p: Culbro Corp said Monday the two remaining conditions for the distribution to its shareholders of all the shares of Griffen Land & Nurseries Inc have been met.
The company also said it expects its previously announced merger into General Cigar Holdings Inc to close by early September.

Culbro said it received a favorable ruling from the Internal Revenue Service as to the tax consequence of the distribution and the declaration of the effectiveness of Griffen's registration by the SEC.
As a result, the company said the board approved the distribution and set the record date for June 25 and the distribution date for on or about July 3.
Griffen operates the non-tobacco business of Culbro while Culbro's cigar business is conducted by General Cigar Holdings.
